run_hyperparameter_search_optuna: run hyperparameter search on a trainer using the Optuna backend with n_trials and direction
run_hyperparameter_search_ray: run hyperparameter search on a trainer using the Ray Tune backend with n_trials and direction
run_hyperparameter_search_wandb: run hyperparameter search on a trainer using the Weights & Biases backend with n_trials and direction
get_default_hp_search_backend: get the default hyperparameter search backend from available Optuna, Ray Tune, or Wandb backends
check_backend_availability: check if a hyperparameter search backend like Optuna, Ray Tune, or Wandb is installed and available
